segments.name: phage therapy
segments.description: Clinical stage company developing natural and engineered phage-based therapies for chronic diseases such as diabetic foot infections.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating segment, as a clinical stage product discovery company developing products using both natural and engineered phage technologies.

changes.text: In December 2025, we discontinued the development of our phage cocktail product for the treatment of Cystic Fibrosis.
